question.problem:
$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{8}{7}xy, & 0\le y\le 1,\,y\le x\le 2 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\,{f}_{Y}(y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{4}{7}y(4-{y}^{2}), & 0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$  be continuous random variables. Their joint probability density function and the marginal probability density function of $Y$ are shown above. Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=\frac{1}{2}]$ given that the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{X|\frac{1}{2}}=\frac{7}{5}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $X$ given $Y=y$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=y] & =\text{E}[(X-{\mu }_{X|y})^{2}\,|\,Y=y] \\  & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Note that $\text{E}[X\,|\,Y=y]$ is a function of $y.$ 

The conditional density function of $X$ given $Y=y$ can be computed as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y) & =\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{Y}(y)} \\  & =\frac{\frac{8}{7}xy}{\frac{4}{7}y(4-{y}^{2})} \\  & =\frac{2x}{4-{y}^{2}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $0\le y\le 1,\,y\le x\le 2.$ Outside this domain, we have ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)=0.$

Now, substituting $y=\frac{1}{2}$ into the expression for ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y),$ we get

$$
{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,\frac{1}{2})=\frac{2x}{(4-{(\frac{1}{2})}^{2})}=\frac{2x}{(\frac{15}{4})}=\frac{8}{15}x.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=\frac{1}{2}] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,\frac{1}{2})\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1/2}^{2}{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{8}{15}x\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{8}{15}{\int }_{1/2}^{2}{x}^{3}\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{8}{15}{[\frac{{x}^{4}}{4}]}_{1/2}^{2} \\  & =\frac{8}{15}\cdot \frac{1}{4}[{x}^{4}]_{1/2}^{2} \\  & =\frac{2}{15}(16-\frac{1}{16}) \\  & =\frac{2}{15}\cdot \frac{255}{16} \\  & =\frac{17}{8}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=\frac{1}{2}] & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=\frac{1}{2}]-{\mu }_{X|\frac{1}{2}}^{2} \\  & =\frac{17}{8}-{(\frac{7}{5})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{17}{8}-\frac{49}{25} \\  & =\frac{33}{200}.\end{aligned}
$$
